title: Assessing the GPU Offload Threshold of GEMM and GEMV Kernels on Modern Heterogeneous HPC Systems
problem: Determining when to offload BLAS kernels (GEMM, GEMV) to GPUs versus executing them on CPUs is non-trivial, as performance depends on problem dimensions, data-to-compute ratios, data reuse patterns, and system architecture. Without systematic characterization, developers cannot confidently predict GPU offload benefits for different problem configurations.
motivation: Heterogeneous HPC systems require principled offload decisions to maximize performance and resource utilization for compute-intensive linear algebra workloads.
method: The authors introduce GPU-BLOB, a portable benchmark that measures CPU and GPU performance across different BLAS kernels (GEMM, GEMV) and problem configurations. The benchmark characterizes the GPU offload threshold—the minimum problem dimensions where GPU acceleration guarantees better performance. It evaluates per-node performance on three production HPC systems with different hardware characteristics. The analysis examines the impact of problem shape and consecutive BLAS call patterns on offload thresholds.
key_novelty: GPU-BLOB systematically characterizes GPU offload thresholds for BLAS kernels across diverse problem configurations and production HPC systems, revealing configuration-dependent performance trade-offs.
contributions: Introduces GPU-BLOB, a portable benchmark for measuring CPU vs GPU performance on BLAS kernels
Demonstrates that GEMM offload thresholds are highly dependent on problem shape and consecutive BLAS call patterns
Shows that GEMV can benefit from GPU acceleration on SoC-based systems, contrary to conventional assumptions
Provides per-node performance characterization across three production HPC systems

metrics.speedup: GPU vs CPU performance ratio for GEMM and GEMV
metrics.other: offload threshold (minimum problem dimensions for GPU advantage)

limitations: Paper abstract does not discuss limitations or failure modes.
primary_theme: GPU offload threshold characterization for BLAS kernels
